evidence.quote: Even before the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Scipio was an important world for the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, being the center world of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, and one of its vault worlds.

facts.text: During the early months of the Imperial Era, Lieutenant Commander Orson Callan Krennic and Admiral Wilhuff Tarkin discussed a plan that would allow the Galactic Empire to seize control of legacy worlds, planets which they currently had no legal right to exploit.

facts.text: Nevertheless, Tarkin understood that meant anti-Imperial groups ranging from their current location at Kartoosh to Scipio would attack it if they knew of its existence, forcing them to ensure their plans for legacy worlds remained secret.
